label: Night Scenery
description: Composite scene descriptions (place + ambience) for night and low-light shots.

items.name: rooftop-parking-deck
items.text: The exposed rooftop level of a concrete open-air parking deck, offering an unobstructed, panoramic view of a dense, glittering city skyline.

items.name: shibuya-crossing
items.text: The center of Shibuya Crossing in Tokyo, the car stationary on the marked asphalt, surrounded by colossal, intensely bright, animated video screens.

items.name: rain-slicked-street
items.text: A generic, rain-slicked (but not actively raining) urban street, with streetlights reflecting off the dark pavement.

items.name: cobblestone-street
items.text: A quiet, empty European cobblestone street, with the ancient stones reflecting the warm glow from window lights.

items.name: empty-boulevard
items.text: A wide, empty boulevard in a major city, lined with closed shops and glowing traffic lights.

items.name: blade-runner-district
items.text: A wide, multi-lane street in a futuristic financial district like 'Blade Runner', where monolithic skyscrapers are adorned with massive, animated holographic advertisements.

items.name: high-tech-street
items.text: A generic high-tech city street, with glowing architectural elements and clean, minimalist lines.

items.name: space-station-hangar
items.text: Inside a futuristic space station hangar bay with a large viewport showing a view of Earth or a nebula.

items.name: underground-hypercar-garage
items.text: An exclusive minimalist underground hypercar garage, with walls of obsidian-like polished stone and concrete, lit by sharp architectural light strips in the floor and ceiling.

items.name: shipping-dock-cranes
items.text: An industrial shipping dock, the scene dominated by the artificial lights of towering container cranes and immense, orderly stacks of cargo containers.

items.name: industrial-back-alley
items.text: A dimly lit back alley behind industrial buildings, with dumpsters and external pipes.

items.name: cooling-towers
items.text: A decommissioned nuclear power plant, with the two massive, concrete cooling towers silhouetted against the night sky and lit by stark, orange-toned security lights at their base.

items.name: flickering-industrial-street
items.text: An old industrial street with flickering streetlights, rusted metal fences, and graffiti-scarred walls.

items.name: deserted-racetrack
items.text: A deserted racetrack, with the empty grandstands and pit lane creating a lonely, silent atmosphere under stark floodlights.

items.name: suspension-bridge-leds
items.text: A sleek, modern suspension bridge, with the elegant geometry of the massive suspension cables and towers lit by programmed architectural LEDs against the dark sky.

items.name: parking-garage-fluorescent
items.text: An empty, multi-level concrete parking garage with stark, repeating fluorescent lighting.

items.name: underwater-tunnel
items.text: A transparent, acrylic underwater tunnel, surrounded by the dark water and deep-sea marine life of a massive aquarium.

items.name: railway-station-forecourt
items.text: The grand, empty forecourt of a historic railway station like St. Pancras International, its intricate ironwork ceiling visible.

items.name: fjord-aurora-dock
items.text: On a quiet wooden dock on a Norwegian fjord, with the shimmering green and purple curtains of the aurora borealis reflecting in the still, dark water.
